rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: At the AICC briefing of 8 October 2022, Central Election Authority chairman Madhusudan Mistry says the period for withdrawal is over that day, 'none of them has withdrawn his candidature', and 'there remain two candidates, Mr. Mallikarjun Kharge and Shri Shashi Tharoor'; the vote will be on the 17th in every state capital and counting on the 19th.
